articles.title: Serpentine Stowaways: King Cobras May Be Commuting by Train Across India
articles.summary: King cobras might be using India's railways to spread into new territory. A herpetologist who started rescuing snakes as a kid found that sightings cluster near train stations. Rats chasing food scraps could be luring the snakes aboard.

articles.title: MIT's New Lidar Chip Gives Autonomous Vehicles a Wider, Clearer View
articles.summary: MIT researchers developed a silicon-photonics chip that eliminates crosstalk between antennas, enabling lidar sensors with a broader field of view and less noise. The advance could shrink lidar systems for use in self-driving cars, drones, and construction monitoring.

articles.title: Ancient Ferns Fueled a Triassic Wildfire Inferno, Fossil Colors Reveal
articles.summary: After the end-Triassic mass extinction, ferns spread across Europe and triggered intense wildfires. Researchers used a new 'Palynomorph Darkness Index' to measure fossil pollen color, finding a dark zone that matches a spike in charcoal and smoke compounds.
